import ast
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
r = Path('/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics')
qa = r / 'docs/papers204_208_sequence/qa'
prep = qa / 'five_paper_terminal_component_launch_preparation'
component = qa / 'five_paper_terminal_gate_preparation'
old = qa / 'p208_p209_reuse_launcher_revision_01/launcher.py'
new = prep / 'launcher.py'
def pin(path):
    h, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
            size += len(chunk)
    return {'sha256': h.hexdigest(), 'bytes': size}
def functions(path):
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_bytes())
    return tree, {n.name: ast.dump(n, include_attributes=False) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
ta, a = functions(old)
tb, b = functions(new)
changed = {'raw_save', 'scoped_inputs', 'native_child', 'main'}
assert set(a) == set(b)
assert {name for name in a if a[name] != b[name]} == changed
compile(tb, str(new), 'exec')
delta = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True), new.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True),
    fromfile='accepted/p208_p209_reuse_launcher_revision_01/launcher.py',
    tofile='prepared/five_paper_terminal_component_launch_preparation/launcher.py'))
assert (prep / 'SOURCE_DELTA.diff').read_text() == delta
literals = {n.targets[0].id: ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tb.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and
            len(n.targets) == 1 and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name) and isinstance(n.value, (ast.Constant, ast.Dict))}
assert literals['CHECKER_SEAL'] == 'b984a1d494d0304a39704da1773782e1f6b10902fa4d8b0dbae77bad86c84e20'
assert literals['CHECKER_SOURCE'] == '0f762c56781041094a0650abcd5b706360722a2afe72aff812485beaa46738bc'
assert literals['ROOT_BINDING_SHA'] == 'b722f61ae2abcc4220a99473b6d9bb104962b52ea509c258f976c0136d08affd'
assert literals['TIMEOUT_SECONDS'] == 600 and literals['HEARTBEAT_SECONDS'] == 30
assert literals['ENV'] == {'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin', 'LANG': 'C.UTF-8', 'LC_ALL': 'C.UTF-8', 'TZ': 'UTC'}
manifest = (component / 'SHA256SUMS').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest() == literals['CHECKER_SEAL'] and manifest.endswith(b'\n')
rows = {}
for line in manifest.decode().splitlines():
    match = re.fullmatch(r'([0-9a-f]{64})  (.+)', line)
    assert match
    digest, name = match.groups()
    p = Path(name)
    assert not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts and p.as_posix() == name and name != 'SHA256SUMS' and name not in rows
    rows[name] = digest
assert len(rows) == 14
entries = list(component.rglob('*'))
assert all(not p.is_symlink() for p in entries)
assert {p.relative_to(component).as_posix() for p in entries if p.is_file()} == set(rows) | {'SHA256SUMS'}
component_pins = {str(component / name): pin(component / name) for name in rows}
assert all(component_pins[str(component / name)]['sha256'] == digest for name, digest in rows.items())
assert component_pins[str(component / 'four_completed.py')]['sha256'] == literals['CHECKER_SOURCE']
assert component_pins[str(component / 'ROOT_REUSE_BINDING.json')]['sha256'] == literals['ROOT_BINDING_SHA']
for name in ('four_completed.py', 'strict_key_selectors.py', 'four_build_key_selectors.py', 'reuse_key_selectors.py'):
    tree = ast.parse((component / name).read_bytes())
    compile(tree, str(component / name), 'exec')
    assert not any(isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)) and
                   any('subprocess' in alias.name for alias in getattr(n, 'names', [])) for n in ast.walk(tree))
    assert not any(isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and
                   n.func.attr in {'write_bytes', 'write_text', 'mkdir', 'unlink', 'rename', 'replace', 'rmdir'} for n in ast.walk(tree))
contract = json.loads((component / 'FOUR_INPUTS.json').read_bytes())
assert len(contract['fixed_inputs']) == 54
fixed = {name: pin(Path(name)) for name in contract['fixed_inputs']}
assert fixed == contract['fixed_inputs']
binding = json.loads((component / 'ROOT_REUSE_BINDING.json').read_bytes())
assert binding['schema'] == 'actual-p208-p209-root-reuse-reception-binding-v1' and binding['not_a_placeholder'] is True
assert binding['native_exit_selector'] == ['result', 'exit_code']
for role in ('native', 'report'):
    assert pin(Path(binding[role])) == binding[role + '_pin']
assert json.loads(Path(binding['native']).read_bytes())['result']['exit_code'] == 0
assert binding['accepted_status'] in Path(binding['report']).read_text()
provenance_paths = [old, qa / 'p208_p209_reuse_launcher_revision_01/SHA256SUMS',
    qa / 'p208_p209_reuse_02/executed_launcher.py', qa / 'p208_p209_reuse_02/SHA256SUMS',
    qa / 'p208_p209_reuse_02/RECEIPT.json', qa / 'P208_P209_REUSE_ROOT_INSPECTION.md',
    qa / 'P208_P209_REUSE_WRAPPER_ROOT_COMPLETION.actual.json',
    r / 'docs/research_state/WORKFLOW.md', r / 'docs/papers204_208_sequence/ARTIFACT_CONTRACT.md']
inputs = {str(path): pin(path) for path in provenance_paths}
assert inputs[str(old)] == inputs[str(qa / 'p208_p209_reuse_02/executed_launcher.py')]
accepted = json.loads((qa / 'p208_p209_reuse_02/RECEIPT.json').read_bytes())
assert accepted['status'] == 'PASS_NATIVE_READ_ONLY_REUSE_LAUNCH_NOT_BATCH_ACCEPTANCE' and accepted['native']['exit'] == 0
assert len([n for n in ast.walk(tb) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr == 'Popen']) == 1
assert not any(isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and n.level for n in ast.walk(tb))
target = qa / 'five_paper_terminal_component_run_01'
assert not os.path.lexists(target)
assert {path.name for path in prep.iterdir()} == {'launcher.py', 'README.md', 'SOURCE_DELTA.diff'}
result = {'status': 'PASS_STATIC_AST_DATA_ONLY_NOT_COMPONENT_EXECUTION',
    'observed_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'source': pin(new), 'source_lines': len(new.read_bytes().splitlines()),
    'unchanged_functions': sorted(set(a) - changed), 'changed_functions': sorted(changed),
    'source_delta': pin(prep / 'SOURCE_DELTA.diff'), 'source_delta_lines': len(delta.splitlines()),
    'inputs': inputs, 'component_preparation_seal': pin(component / 'SHA256SUMS'),
    'component_source_and_payload_pins': component_pins, 'component_payloads_hashed': len(rows),
    'fixed_component_input_pins_checked': fixed, 'fixed_component_input_count': len(fixed),
    'binding': {'path': str(component / 'ROOT_REUSE_BINDING.json'), **pin(component / 'ROOT_REUSE_BINDING.json')},
    'compiler_scope': 'AST compilation only; no launcher/component/selector/old auditor imported or executed.',
    'static_data_scope': 'All 14 sealed component payloads, 54 fixed input byte pins, actual root binding and accepted-launcher source identity; no recursive component key audit or runtime inventory.',
    'planned_owned_native_commands': 1, 'planned_successful_output_payloads': 20,
    'new_scientific_executions': 0, 'component_executions': 0, 'new_builds': 0, 'new_views': 0,
    'expected_launch_status_only': 'PASS_NATIVE_FOUR_COMPLETED_COMPONENT_NOT_FIVE_PAPER_ACCEPTANCE',
    'target_absent': str(target), 'five_paper_pass': False, 'owner': 'OWNER_AMBER', 'external': 'HOLD_EXTERNAL'}
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
